listing:promotional_text.back: Scan a page, import a PDF or paste your notes. QuickStudy drafts flashcards and quizzes for you, then shows you each day only what is to be reviewed.

listing:keywords.note: 98/100 chars, native French student search terms, no app name.

listing:description.back: QuickStudy turns the pages you already have into flashcards you will really study. Scan a worksheet, import a PDF or paste your notes: QuickStudy drafts the cards, links each to its source and schedules them so you only review what needs it. [...] BUILD THE HABIT OF STUDYING EVERY DAY [...] A timer and a progress bar help you keep each session short [...] Reviews, quizzes and edits work offline [...] FREE AND PRO: 10 free AI generations a month; manual cards and all study modes always free and unlimited. QuickStudy Pro adds 150 cloud generations a month on any iPhone. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.
listing:description.note: Fixed the tautology 'pour que tu ne révises que ce qui est à réviser' → 'ce qui doit l’être'; calque 'gardent chaque session courte' → 't’aident à garder ...'; 'INSTALLE UNE HABITUDE' → 'PRENDS L’HABITUDE D’ÉTUDIER CHAQUE JOUR'; ungrammatical 'Étudier, faire des quiz et modifier fonctionnent' → 'Les révisions, les quiz et les modifications fonctionnent'. All pricing, renewal and 30-day claims verified unchanged.

listing:release_notes.back: QuickStudy now speaks your language. The app is available in Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean and Portuguese, and cards are drafted in the language of your notes, whatever your iPhone's language. Scanning also reads pages in these languages, and spell checking follows each page's language.
